**indexOf(-1) slicing mangles a line in silence (#882)**

parseTagList sliced on indexOf('|') without guarding -1, so a line with no separator lost its last character and leaked the rest into the date. The fix is the same rule the rest of this codebase already follows: keep the malformed row and name its problem.
